notable_observations = transpose(notable_obs_ojs)

// Create a dropdown menu of the county name.
viewof countyDropdown = Inputs.select(
  notable_observations.map(d => d.subnational2Name),
  {
    label: "Choose a county",
    unique: true, // Only include each location once.
    sort: true // Sort the options alphabetically.
    }
)
// Create a dropdown menu of the city name.
viewof cityNameDropdown = Inputs.select(
  Array.from(new Set(notable_observations.filter(d => d.subnational2Name === countyDropdown)
  .map(d => d.City))),
  {
    label: "Choose a city",
    unique: true, // Only include each location once.
    sort: true // Sort the options alphabetically.
    }
)
filtered_county = notable_observations.filter(d => d.City === cityNameDropdown);

// Create a horizontal bar chart using Observable Plot.
Plot.plot({
  title: "Notable Observations for " + cityNameDropdown,
  marginLeft: 175,
  height: filtered_county.length * 5 + 100,
  width: undefined,
  x: {
    label: "Number Observed"
  },
  y: {
    label: "Species Common Name"
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(filtered_county, 
      Plot.groupY(
      {x: "sum"}, // Take the sum of the howMany values for each species.
      {y: "comName", 
      x: "howMany",
      sort: { y: "x", reverse: true }, // Sort data largest to smallest.
      fill: "#888"})),
    // Add data labels
    Plot.text(filtered_county, 
      Plot.groupY(
      {x: "sum"}, 
      {y: "comName", 
      x: "howMany",
      text: d => d3.sum(d.map(x => x.howMany)),
      dx: -17,
      dy: 0,
      fill: "#fff",
      textAnchor: "start",
    })),
      ]
})
